stocks.impact_theory: Rising oil prices due to ongoing US-Iran tensions and higher Treasury yields are pressuring growth stocks like NVDA ahead of earnings. Historical parallel: 2022 rate-hike selloff in tech. Analogies: 1) Like a sprinter facing headwinds after a tailwind sprint. 2) Oil spike acts as a tax on the economy, slowing AI capex enthusiasm.

news_impact_analysis.reasoning: X posts and news show futures down on oil/yields; NVDA mentioned dropping ~2% premarket. Sentiment shift negative amid macro concerns despite strong AI fundamentals. Earnings Aug 26 looms.

potential_profit_risks.short_position: Short or hedge with puts into earnings/vol spike (-5-10% downside risk if macro worsens)
potential_profit_risks.key_risks: AI demand resilience, unexpected positive Fed minutes, or oil de-escalation could reverse quickly
